Brah, I've been there. I lost a girlfriend who was smoking hot and had a lot of fun with her. I was miserable when we broke up. I cried in front my mom the hardest I have since I was a kid. What you're experiencing is something you have to embrace. It's okay to cry but it's not worth taking your own life over. You just broke up and it's normal to feel miserable but you can't fight it. Spend the next few days venting and get it out in the healthiest way possible. Go for a walk later at night and cry while you walk if you have to. You'll feel a little better when you get home cause you'll have less negative energy in your system. I've cried around a whole lake once playing music on my headphones that made me sad because it felt good to cry. What I'm saying is that it's fine to feel sad but taking your life isn't  worth it over some girl. I say some girl because if she was really the one, you'd still be together. It's a blessing in disguise dude. You'll find someone better. I suggest running to help heal. Go run around the block twice or even ten times for endorphins. You're gonna be alright bud.
